
## Changes

- Move phone sign-in, signup, remote paste, search, avatar upload and artwork tools to the secure GitHub Pages companion with encrypted, five-minute Neon pairing sessions.
- Remove local self-signed HTTPS pairing and fix expired pairing, QR reconnection and image-picker expiry handling.
- Use rectangular artwork at the application level for Fire TV launchers while retaining the standard Android adaptive icon.
- Improve account password visibility controls, explicit keyboard activation and exit confirmation.
- Fix update installation state handling.

## Verification

157 local JVM tests passed; release lint reported no errors. Encrypted relay isolation, acknowledgement, closure and real five-minute expiry checks passed. Physical Fire TV rendering and real-phone image-picker uploads still require device verification.

This release is the signed 32-bit (armeabi-v7a) build for Android 8.0 and newer, using the existing Saab TV release key.
